en.text:
Drawing from the hip marks up to 3 enemies near the reticle. Releasing the trigger fires lock-on arrows that apply 'Sacred Flame' to each marked target for <pve [10] /> <pvp [5] /> seconds.

Enemies marked by Sacred Flame explode on death, dealing <pve 295 /> <pvp [137] /> damage in a 5.5 meter radius. If a Sacred Flame explosion hits other marked enemies, they too explode.

Sacred Flame explosions are reduced by 50% damage at the edge of their radius.
